description: Durvalumab is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as neoadjuvant treatment with platinum-based chemotherapy, then continued alone as adjuvant treatment, for treating resectable (tumours 4cm or over, or node positive) non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults whose cancer has no EGFR mutations or ALK rearrangements. Durvalumab is only recommended if the company provides it according to the commercial arrangement.
